techniques.comment: AGC-047: Pass-the-Hash with shared local admin (wadmin). Security EID 4624: wadmin Type 3, NtLmSsp, NTLM V2, Elevated Token: No. No interactive precursor. SAM registry query attempt (access denied). net use \\10.10.10.102\C$ /user:wadmin failed (error 64). Localhost ADMIN$ denied (UAC filtering). WMI succeeded. Root enabler: identical local admin password across hosts. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.
